name: Nam3L3ss
description: Nam3L3ss is a multi‑sector threat actor that recently capitalized on the CVE‑2023‑34362 vulnerability in Progress Software’s MOVEit file transfer application, enabling widespread data exfiltration and extortion against thousands of organizations worldwide. The actors monetise stolen personal and corporate data by threatening to publish it or by deploying ransomware such as Clop, while simultaneously offering access to the compromised repositories on underground forums. Their activities reflect a supply‑chain focused strategy that leverages third‑party vendor ecosystems to reach critical enterprise assets across government, defense, finance, energy, and many other sectors.
